## The Keys to Passing the CPA Exam: Tips and Tricks

![](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/CHFzrlUDqm8/hq720.jpg)

Abby Aslan, a successful CPA examiner with a Big Four accounting firm in Texas, shares her tips and experiences on how to pass the CPA Exam in just five months. With her impressive accomplishments and useful tips, Aslan will guide you through the steps to pass the CPA Exam and become a successful CPA. 

## The Importance of Discipline and Perseverance

The CPA Exam is a challenging test that requires a tremendous amount of dedication and discipline. Aslan emphasises the importance of setting a study schedule and sticking to it. She encourages future CPA examiners to take advantage of their free time, whether it is waking up early or staying up late, to study and review course materials. Furthermore, Aslan advises examiners to take breaks to prevent burnout and to give their brains time to rest.

## Understanding the Sections and Order of the Exam

Aslan provides her tips on the best order to take the exam sections, based on her personal experience. She found it helpful to start with the section she was most comfortable with and to end with the most challenging section. Aslan notes that the exam consists of four sections: Regulation, Auditing and Attestation, Business Environment and Concepts, and Financial Accounting and Reporting. Examiners are given four hours to complete each section, and they must score 75 or higher to pass.

## Utilising a Study Schedule and Practice Exams

Aslan reveals her study schedule and provides a template that other examiners can use. She recommends using a planner or calendar to schedule study times and breaks. Aslan also suggests practising with sample exams and reviewing the results to identify areas that need improvement. She notes that taking practice exams helps examiners to familiarise themselves with the exam format and to better manage their time during the actual test.

## Conclusion

Aslan's advice is invaluable to anyone preparing to take the CPA Exam. Her tips emphasise the importance of discipline, perseverance, and time management. Following her suggestions on studying schedules, exam order, and utilising sample exams, aspiring CPAs can be well-prepared to pass the exam. With her dedication and success as a CPA examiner, Aslan is an excellent role model for future CPAs.
